topic: US government Earth-observation satellites/missions: free + commercial-use data

NASA.text: NASA Earthdata data-use guidance: unless marked otherwise, data from NASA-led missions are licensed CC0; 'no restrictions on the use of these data' (citation strongly urged).

policy_notes.NASA_partner_rule: NASA Data & Information Policy: no exclusive-access period; for products from international partners or other agencies NASA restricts access only as an MOU requires. https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/engage/open-data-services-software-policies/data-information-policy

USGS.text: USGS: 'There are no restrictions on Landsat data downloaded from the USGS; it can be used or redistributed as desired' (source statement requested). USGS-produced data are US public domain.

NOAA.text: NOAA NODD: data 'are open to the public and can be used as desired'; NOAA requests attribution and no implied endorsement.
